         <h2 class="project-title">Advanced A/B: Search Ranking Metrics</h2>
         <p class="project-subhead">SRM · Ratio Metrics · Bootstrap</p>
         <div class="detail-tools"><span class="label">Executed notebook · Read-only website version</span>

         <div class="nb-container"><div class="cell border-box-sizing text_cell rendered" id="cell-id=c30441a3"><div class="inner_cell">
<div class="text_cell_render border-box-sizing rendered_html">
<p><strong>Track:</strong> Experimentation / Search<br/>
<strong>Research / product question:</strong> Why did the new ranking algorithm increase clicks but decrease purchases—and is logging trustworthy?</p>
<p><strong>Learning outcome:</strong> Detect SRM, reconcile event logging, user-level ratio metrics, bootstrap, segments and guardrail tradeoffs.</p>
<p><strong>Workflow:</strong> Data-generating process → raw-data audit → leakage-safe features → from-scratch baseline → model selection / hyperparameter tuning → held-out evaluation → failure analysis.</p>
<blockquote>
<p><strong>Synthetic-data disclosure:</strong> All records and outcomes are created in this notebook; they do not describe real customers or credit decisions. Ground truth is constructed for teaching. Numerical results are illustrative of this simulator, not estimates of real-world business impact.</p>
</blockquote>
<p><strong>Reproducibility:</strong> Random seeds are fixed. Run cells top-to-bottom. Install packages from the project-level <code>requirements.txt</code>. CPU execution is supported; deep-learning examples deliberately use small models.</p>
</div>
</div>
</div>
<div class="cell border-box-sizing text_cell rendered" id="cell-id=88f1a3d1"><div class="inner_cell">
<div class="text_cell_render border-box-sizing rendered_html">
<blockquote>
<p><strong>Portfolio standard:</strong> fully reproducible, synthetic educational data · explicit evaluation protocol · plots and failure analysis · no claims of production accuracy.</p>
</blockquote>
<p>Simulate a logging bug that drops treatment records. Repair the <strong>measurement population</strong> before making causal claims; use user-level bootstrap because users contribute multiple impressions.</p>
</div>
</div>
</div>
<div class="cell border-box-sizing code_cell rendered" id="cell-id=89a61c20">
<details class="code-block" open=""><summary>Python source · Cell 1</summary><div class="input">
<div class="inner_cell">
<div class="input_area">
<div class="highlight hl-ipython3"><pre><span></span><span class="kn">import</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nn">numpy</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="k">as</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nn">np</span>
<span class="kn">import</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nn">pandas</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="k">as</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nn">pd</span>
<span class="kn">import</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nn">matplotlib.pyplot</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="k">as</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nn">plt</span>
<span class="kn">from</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nn">sklearn.model_selection</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="kn">import</span> <span class="n">train_test_split</span>
<span class="n">SEED</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="mi">42</span>
<span class="n">rng</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="n">np</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">random</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">default_rng</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">SEED</span><span class="p">)</span>
<span class="n">plt</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">rcParams</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">update</span><span class="p">({</span><span class="s1">'figure.figsize'</span><span class="p">:</span> <span class="p">(</span><span class="mi">8</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="mi">4</span><span class="p">),</span> <span class="s1">'axes.grid'</span><span class="p">:</span> <span class="kc">True</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="s1">'grid.alpha'</span><span class="p">:</span> <span class="mf">0.2</span><span class="p">})</span>
</pre></div>
</div>

<div class="cell border-box-sizing text_cell rendered" id="cell-id=0fca5049"><div class="inner_cell">
<div class="text_cell_render border-box-sizing rendered_html">
<h2 id="1.-Simulate-repeated-user-search-sessions-and-a-logging-bug">1. Simulate repeated user search sessions and a logging bug</h2><p>The unit of randomization is <strong>user</strong>, not impression. Treatment makes clickier but lower-intent products more prominent, increasing CTR but reducing purchase conversion. Separately, a logging bug drops treatment users.</p>
</div>
</div>
</div>
<div class="cell border-box-sizing code_cell rendered" id="cell-id=8a9ed443">
<details class="code-block" open=""><summary>Python source · Cell 2</summary><div class="input">
<div class="inner_cell">
<div class="input_area">
<div class="highlight hl-ipython3"><pre><span></span><span class="c1"># Simulate logging loss separately from treatment assignment.</span>
<span class="kn">from</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nn">scipy.stats</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="kn">import</span> <span class="n">chisquare</span>
<span class="n">n</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="mi">9000</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="n">users</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="n">np</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">arange</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">n</span><span class="p">);</span><span class="n">D</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="n">rng</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">binomial</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="mi">1</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="mf">.5</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="n">n</span><span class="p">);</span><span class="n">mobile</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="n">rng</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">binomial</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="mi">1</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="mf">.64</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="n">n</span><span class="p">);</span><span class="n">intent</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="n">rng</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">beta</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="mi">2</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="mi">4</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="n">n</span><span class="p">)</span>
<span class="n">impressions</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="n">rng</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">poisson</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="mi">9</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="n">n</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="o">+</span><span class="mi">2</span>
<span class="n">click_p</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="n">np</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">clip</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="mf">.16</span><span class="o">+</span><span class="mf">.055</span><span class="o">*</span><span class="n">D</span><span class="o">+</span><span class="mf">.10</span><span class="o">*</span><span class="n">intent</span><span class="o">-</span><span class="mf">.035</span><span class="o">*</span><span class="n">mobile</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="mf">.02</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="mf">.8</span><span class="p">)</span>
<span class="n">clicks</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="n">rng</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">binomial</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">impressions</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="n">click_p</span><span class="p">)</span>
<span class="n">purch_prob</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="n">np</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">clip</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="mf">.075</span><span class="o">+</span><span class="mf">.13</span><span class="o">*</span><span class="n">intent</span><span class="o">-</span><span class="mf">.035</span><span class="o">*</span><span class="n">D</span><span class="o">+</span><span class="mf">.018</span><span class="o">*</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="mi">1</span><span class="o">-</span><span class="n">mobile</span><span class="p">),</span><span class="mf">.003</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="mf">.5</span><span class="p">)</span>
<span class="n">purchases</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="n">rng</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">binomial</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="mi">1</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="n">purch_prob</span><span class="p">)</span>
<span class="n">revenue</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="n">purchases</span><span class="o">*</span><span class="n">rng</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">lognormal</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="mf">4.65</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="mf">1.0</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="n">n</span><span class="p">)</span>
<span class="n">latency</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="n">rng</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">normal</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="mi">125</span><span class="o">+</span><span class="mi">25</span><span class="o">*</span><span class="n">D</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="mi">15</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="n">n</span><span class="p">)</span>
<span class="n">assigned</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="n">pd</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">DataFrame</span><span class="p">({</span><span class="s1">'user'</span><span class="p">:</span><span class="n">users</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="s1">'treat'</span><span class="p">:</span><span class="n">D</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="s1">'mobile'</span><span class="p">:</span><span class="n">mobile</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="s1">'impressions'</span><span class="p">:</span><span class="n">impressions</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="s1">'clicks'</span><span class="p">:</span><span class="n">clicks</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="s1">'purchase'</span><span class="p">:</span><span class="n">purchases</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="s1">'revenue'</span><span class="p">:</span><span class="n">revenue</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="s1">'latency'</span><span class="p">:</span><span class="n">latency</span><span class="p">})</span>
<span class="c1"># Bug: some treatment users are not logged, regardless of their purchase outcome.</span>
<span class="n">logged</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="n">assigned</span><span class="p">[</span><span class="o">~</span><span class="p">((</span><span class="n">assigned</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">treat</span><span class="o">==</span><span class="mi">1</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="o">&amp;</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">rng</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">random</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">n</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="o">&lt;</span><span class="mf">.15</span><span class="p">))]</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">copy</span><span class="p">()</span>
<span class="nb">print</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="s1">'Assigned sizes:'</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="n">assigned</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">treat</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">value_counts</span><span class="p">()</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">to_dict</span><span class="p">(),</span><span class="s1">'Logged sizes:'</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="n">logged</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">treat</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">value_counts</span><span class="p">()</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">to_dict</span><span class="p">())</span>
</pre></div>
</div>
</div>
</div></details>

<div class="cell border-box-sizing text_cell rendered" id="cell-id=26f5578f"><div class="inner_cell">
<div class="text_cell_render border-box-sizing rendered_html">
<h2 id="2.-Diagnose-sample-ratio-mismatch-(SRM)">2. Diagnose sample ratio mismatch (SRM)</h2><p>Always check SRM before interpreting treatment effects. A large discrepancy suggests an assignment, exposure or logging issue. Here the correct action is to <strong>repair the analysis dataset</strong> using the original assignments, not to silently analyze the biased sample.</p>
</div>
</div>
</div>
<div class="cell border-box-sizing code_cell rendered" id="cell-id=0867a59c">
<details class="code-block"><summary>Python source · Cell 3</summary><div class="input">
<div class="inner_cell">
<div class="input_area">
<div class="highlight hl-ipython3"><pre><span></span><span class="c1"># Diagnose SRM on logs and distinguish it from randomization imbalance.</span>
<span class="k">def</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nf">check_srm</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">f</span><span class="p">):</span>
 <span class="n">obs</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="n">f</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">treat</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">value_counts</span><span class="p">()</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">reindex</span><span class="p">([</span><span class="mi">0</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="mi">1</span><span class="p">],</span><span class="n">fill_value</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="mi">0</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">to_numpy</span><span class="p">();</span><span class="k">return</span> <span class="n">chisquare</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">obs</span><span class="p">,[</span><span class="nb">len</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">f</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="o">/</span><span class="mi">2</span><span class="p">]</span><span class="o">*</span><span class="mi">2</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">pvalue</span>
<span class="nb">print</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="s1">'SRM p, corrupted logs:'</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="n">check_srm</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">logged</span><span class="p">))</span>
<span class="nb">print</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="s1">'SRM p, reconstructed user-level assignments:'</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="n">check_srm</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">assigned</span><span class="p">))</span>
<span class="k">assert</span> <span class="nb">set</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">logged</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">user</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">issubset</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="nb">set</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">assigned</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">user</span><span class="p">))</span>
<span class="c1"># Simulated repair: we have access to independently recorded exposures and outcomes.</span>
<span class="n">experiment</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="n">assigned</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">copy</span><span class="p">()</span>
<span class="n">fig</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="n">ax</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="n">plt</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">subplots</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">figsize</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="mi">6</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="mi">3</span><span class="p">));</span><span class="n">pd</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">DataFrame</span><span class="p">({</span><span class="s1">'Assigned'</span><span class="p">:</span><span class="n">assigned</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">treat</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">value_counts</span><span class="p">()</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">sort_index</span><span class="p">(),</span><span class="s1">'Corrupted log'</span><span class="p">:</span><span class="n">logged</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">treat</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">value_counts</span><span class="p">()</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">sort_index</span><span class="p">()})</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">plot</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">bar</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">ax</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="n">ax</span><span class="p">);</span><span class="n">ax</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">set</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">xlabel</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="s1">'Experiment arm'</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="n">ylabel</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="s1">'Unique users'</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="n">title</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="s1">'SRM caused by missing treatment logs'</span><span class="p">);</span><span class="n">plt</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">tight_layout</span><span class="p">();</span><span class="n">plt</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">show</span><span class="p">()</span>
</pre></div>
</div>

<div class="cell border-box-sizing text_cell rendered" id="cell-id=4dc9bed8"><div class="inner_cell">
<div class="text_cell_render border-box-sizing rendered_html">
<h2 id="3.-Correct-metric-definitions-and-bootstrap-uncertainty">3. Correct metric definitions and bootstrap uncertainty</h2><p>CTR is a <strong>ratio of sums</strong>: total clicks / total impressions. Bootstrap users (the randomized unit) to preserve their repeated impressions. Revenue per user is averaged over <strong>all randomized users</strong>, including zero-purchase users.</p>
</div>
</div>
</div>
<div class="cell border-box-sizing code_cell rendered" id="cell-id=4cbfe7f0">
<details class="code-block"><summary>Python source · Cell 4</summary><div class="input">
<div class="inner_cell">
<div class="input_area">
<div class="highlight hl-ipython3"><pre><span></span><span class="c1"># Use per-user bootstrap for repeated search impressions.</span>
<span class="k">def</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nf">metrics</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">f</span><span class="p">):</span>
 <span class="k">return</span> <span class="n">f</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">groupby</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="s1">'treat'</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">apply</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="k">lambda</span> <span class="n">g</span><span class="p">:</span><span class="n">pd</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">Series</span><span class="p">({</span><span class="s1">'CTR'</span><span class="p">:</span><span class="n">g</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">clicks</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">sum</span><span class="p">()</span><span class="o">/</span><span class="n">g</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">impressions</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">sum</span><span class="p">(),</span><span class="s1">'Revenue/user'</span><span class="p">:</span><span class="n">g</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">revenue</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">mean</span><span class="p">(),</span><span class="s1">'Purchase/user'</span><span class="p">:</span><span class="n">g</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">purchase</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">mean</span><span class="p">(),</span><span class="s1">'Latency'</span><span class="p">:</span><span class="n">g</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">latency</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">mean</span><span class="p">()}),</span><span class="n">include_groups</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="kc">False</span><span class="p">)</span>
<span class="n">summary</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="n">metrics</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">experiment</span><span class="p">);</span><span class="nb">print</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="s1">'Metrics by arm:</span><span class="se">\n</span><span class="s1">'</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="n">summary</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">round</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="mi">4</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">to_string</span><span class="p">());</span><span class="nb">print</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="s1">'Treated minus control:</span><span class="se">\n</span><span class="s1">'</span><span class="p">,(</span><span class="n">summary</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">loc</span><span class="p">[</span><span class="mi">1</span><span class="p">]</span><span class="o">-</span><span class="n">summary</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">loc</span><span class="p">[</span><span class="mi">0</span><span class="p">])</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">round</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="mi">4</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">to_string</span><span class="p">())</span>
<span class="n">control</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="n">experiment</span><span class="p">[</span><span class="n">experiment</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">treat</span><span class="o">==</span><span class="mi">0</span><span class="p">];</span><span class="n">treated</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="n">experiment</span><span class="p">[</span><span class="n">experiment</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">treat</span><span class="o">==</span><span class="mi">1</span><span class="p">];</span><span class="n">r</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="n">np</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">random</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">default_rng</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="mi">42</span><span class="p">);</span><span class="n">boot</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="p">[]</span>
<span class="k">for</span> <span class="n">i</span> <span class="ow">in</span> <span class="nb">range</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="mi">350</span><span class="p">):</span>
 <span class="n">a</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="n">treated</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">iloc</span><span class="p">[</span><span class="n">r</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">integers</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="nb">len</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">treated</span><span class="p">),</span><span class="n">size</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="nb">len</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">treated</span><span class="p">))];</span><span class="n">b</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="n">control</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">iloc</span><span class="p">[</span><span class="n">r</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">integers</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="nb">len</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">control</span><span class="p">),</span><span class="n">size</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="nb">len</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">control</span><span class="p">))]</span>
 <span class="n">boot</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">append</span><span class="p">([</span><span class="n">a</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">clicks</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">sum</span><span class="p">()</span><span class="o">/</span><span class="n">a</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">impressions</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">sum</span><span class="p">()</span><span class="o">-</span><span class="n">b</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">clicks</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">sum</span><span class="p">()</span><span class="o">/</span><span class="n">b</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">impressions</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">sum</span><span class="p">(),</span><span class="n">a</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">revenue</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">mean</span><span class="p">()</span><span class="o">-</span><span class="n">b</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">revenue</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">mean</span><span class="p">()])</span>
<span class="n">boot</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="n">np</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">array</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">boot</span><span class="p">);</span><span class="n">CIs</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="n">np</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">quantile</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">boot</span><span class="p">,[</span><span class="mf">.025</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="mf">.975</span><span class="p">],</span><span class="n">axis</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="mi">0</span><span class="p">)</span>
<span class="nb">print</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="s1">'User-bootstrap 95% CI: CTR'</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="n">CIs</span><span class="p">[:,</span><span class="mi">0</span><span class="p">]</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">round</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="mi">4</span><span class="p">),</span><span class="s1">'Revenue/user'</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="n">CIs</span><span class="p">[:,</span><span class="mi">1</span><span class="p">]</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">round</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="mi">2</span><span class="p">))</span>
<span class="n">fig</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="n">ax</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="n">plt</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">subplots</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="mi">1</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="mi">2</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="n">figsize</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="mi">11</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="mi">3</span><span class="p">));</span><span class="n">ax</span><span class="p">[</span><span class="mi">0</span><span class="p">]</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">hist</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">boot</span><span class="p">[:,</span><span class="mi">0</span><span class="p">],</span><span class="n">bins</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="mi">28</span><span class="p">);</span><span class="n">ax</span><span class="p">[</span><span class="mi">0</span><span class="p">]</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">set</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">title</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="s1">'CTR effect uncertainty'</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="n">xlabel</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="s1">'Absolute CTR lift'</span><span class="p">);</span><span class="n">ax</span><span class="p">[</span><span class="mi">1</span><span class="p">]</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">hist</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">boot</span><span class="p">[:,</span><span class="mi">1</span><span class="p">],</span><span class="n">bins</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="mi">28</span><span class="p">);</span><span class="n">ax</span><span class="p">[</span><span class="mi">1</span><span class="p">]</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">set</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">title</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="s1">'Revenue per user effect'</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="n">xlabel</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="s1">'Dollars per user'</span><span class="p">);</span><span class="n">plt</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">tight_layout</span><span class="p">();</span><span class="n">plt</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">show</span><span class="p">()</span>
</pre></div>
</div>
</div>
</div></details>

<div class="cell border-box-sizing text_cell rendered" id="cell-id=5e07705e"><div class="inner_cell">
<div class="text_cell_render border-box-sizing rendered_html">
<h2 id="4.-Segment-analysis,-tails-and-sensitivity">4. Segment analysis, tails and sensitivity</h2><p>Segment effects can be noisy and susceptible to multiple testing. Treat this analysis as exploratory, not a replacement for the randomized primary decision. Revenue’s lognormal tail motivates robust diagnostics.</p>
</div>
</div>
</div>
<div class="cell border-box-sizing code_cell rendered" id="cell-id=d147aa38">
<details class="code-block"><summary>Python source · Cell 5</summary><div class="input">
<div class="inner_cell">
<div class="input_area">
<div class="highlight hl-ipython3"><pre><span></span><span class="c1"># Investigate device segments, revenue tails and metric conflicts.</span>
<span class="nb">print</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="s1">'Device-level outcomes:'</span><span class="p">)</span>
<span class="k">for</span> <span class="n">mob</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="n">grp</span> <span class="ow">in</span> <span class="n">experiment</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">groupby</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="s1">'mobile'</span><span class="p">):</span>
 <span class="n">m</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="n">metrics</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">grp</span><span class="p">);</span><span class="nb">print</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="s1">'Mobile'</span> <span class="k">if</span> <span class="n">mob</span> <span class="k">else</span> <span class="s1">'Desktop'</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="s1">'CTR effect'</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="nb">round</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">m</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">loc</span><span class="p">[</span><span class="mi">1</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="s1">'CTR'</span><span class="p">]</span><span class="o">-</span><span class="n">m</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">loc</span><span class="p">[</span><span class="mi">0</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="s1">'CTR'</span><span class="p">],</span><span class="mi">3</span><span class="p">),</span><span class="s1">'Revenue/user effect'</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="nb">round</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">m</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">loc</span><span class="p">[</span><span class="mi">1</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="s1">'Revenue/user'</span><span class="p">]</span><span class="o">-</span><span class="n">m</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">loc</span><span class="p">[</span><span class="mi">0</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="s1">'Revenue/user'</span><span class="p">],</span><span class="mi">2</span><span class="p">))</span>
<span class="nb">print</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="s1">'Revenue by percentile:'</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="n">np</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">quantile</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">experiment</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">revenue</span><span class="p">,[</span><span class="mf">.5</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="mf">.9</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="mf">.99</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="mf">.999</span><span class="p">])</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">round</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="mi">1</span><span class="p">))</span>
<span class="nb">print</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="s1">'Winsorized revenue check (not a substitute for preregistration):'</span><span class="p">)</span>
<span class="n">cap</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="n">experiment</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">revenue</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">quantile</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="mf">.99</span><span class="p">);</span><span class="n">clip</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="n">experiment</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">assign</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">revenue</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="n">experiment</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">revenue</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">clip</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">upper</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="n">cap</span><span class="p">));</span><span class="nb">print</span><span class="p">((</span><span class="n">metrics</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">clip</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">loc</span><span class="p">[</span><span class="mi">1</span><span class="p">]</span><span class="o">-</span><span class="n">metrics</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">clip</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">loc</span><span class="p">[</span><span class="mi">0</span><span class="p">])</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">round</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="mi">3</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">to_string</span><span class="p">())</span>
</pre></div>
</div>
</div>
</div></details>

<div class="cell border-box-sizing text_cell rendered" id="cell-id=90bd79d6"><div class="inner_cell">
<div class="text_cell_render border-box-sizing rendered_html">
<h2 id="What-the-results-mean-/-interview-discussion">What the results mean / interview discussion</h2><p>The correct conclusion starts with logging integrity. Once repaired, an experiment can genuinely show <strong>higher engagement but lower purchase value</strong>. Avoid choosing a metric only because it improved; business decisions should use a predeclared primary OEC, guardrails and uncertainty.</p>
<p><strong>Try explaining these without looking at the code:</strong></p>
<ol>
<li>How can SRM be caused by dropped tracking events?</li>
<li>Why is average per-session CTR not the same as global CTR?</li>
<li>Why should user be the bootstrap unit here?</li>
</ol>
<p><strong>Limitations and next step:</strong> Evaluate on a suitably licensed real-world dataset or stronger simulation with domain shift, logging bias and realistic selection. Never treat synthetic performance as production evidence.</p>

(function(){
  const root=document.getElementById('wtp');if(!root)return;
  const button=root.querySelector('#wtp-toggle-code');
  if(button){button.addEventListener('click',()=>{
    const blocks=Array.from(root.querySelectorAll('details.code-block'));
    const shouldOpen=blocks.some(el=>!el.open);
    blocks.forEach(el=>{el.open=shouldOpen;});
    button.textContent=shouldOpen?'Collapse code':'Expand code';
  });}
})();
</script>
